name: beethoven-qa
description: The code-writing and verification plugin of the Beethoven engine, for any repository that runs its gate with pixi run gate. Beethoven runs Claude Code and is not an Anthropic product; "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic's marks, used here to say what it runs.

plugins.name: beethoven-qa
plugins.description: Skills that state the definition of done, a build-stream agent that works in its own worktree, and workflows that fix the gate until green, prove one module, and improve one module without changing its behaviour.
